Class Themes

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Themes
public final class Themes extends Object
The look of every Tempest menu, chosen by the admin (/tempest, General, "Menu theme"): a preset or their own colours. The default theme is the plugins' own look, so nothing changes until an admin picks another. (API version 3) 
cmd.append("Pages/MyName_Dragons/DragonsPage.ui");
Themes.tint(cmd, "#Content");                                  // the page's body in the theme's colour
cmd.set("#Title.TextSpans", Message.raw("Dragons").color(Themes.accent()));
Themes.paint(cmd, "#List[0]", Themes.current().row());         // a row in the theme's row colour
